answer_1.quote: In video captioning, the task is to generate a natural language description capturing the content of a video.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the captioning performance at paragraph-level, following , reporting numbers on standard metrics, including BLEU@4 , METEOR , CIDEr-D . ... Thus, we follow previous works to evaluate repetition using R@4.

answer_4.quote: we also run human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) with 200 randomly sampled videos from ActivityNet Captions ae-test split, where each video was judged by three different AMT workers.
answer_4.guideline: AMT workers are instructed to choose which caption is better or the two captions are not distinguishable based on relevance and coherence, respectively.
